assumptions: Each reading is the graded function it names, run on the same events.
limits: Flow-rate anomalies and time drift are the Quality tools (check_flow_cytometry_quality), not repeated here.
bio.jane/contract.question: What does this file support, read before any question is asked?

description: What an FCS file supports before any question (dynamic synthesis): channel roles, the events at each channel's storable maximum, the logicle flowCore estimateLogicle fits to each fluorescence channel's instrument range, flowDensity deGate's density valleys per scaled channel, and every population's share of its parent with its exact (Clopper–Pearson, R binom.test) interval.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

asinh_a.description: the a in asinh(a + b·x) + c.

asinh_b.description: the b in asinh(a + b·x) + c.

asinh_c.description: the c in asinh(a + b·x) + c.

conf_level.description: the confidence level of every population interval.

document.description: the FCS file in the project, by name or id.

gating.description: a Gating-ML or FlowJo .wsp in the project; empty for none.

name: synthesize_flow_cytometry

channels.description: per channel: role, events at maximum, the fitted logicle and the density valleys

populations.description: per population: count, % of parent and that share's exact interval
